entries.notes: Subject is the entity, not a category — a platform cannot sign a contract (spec chrome.footer.tagline). Wording of the relationship is the proof-bank §F licence verbatim: member of the group, never subsidiary, no ownership figure. Sits under the 'Pebble Vina' heading, so the name is not repeated.

locales.vi: Thành viên của nhóm Pebble Square, ký hợp đồng và xuất hoá đơn tại Việt Nam.

entries.notes: Regenerated from the spec and landed on the existing string. Plain, accurate, not CMS furniture; also serves as the nav aria-label.

Was 'Kênh liên hệ' — 'channels' is translation smell (critic). Bare 'Liên hệ' was rejected by STYLE_DUPLICATE_TEXT against nav.contact and would have put an identical word in two adjacent footer columns; 'Thông tin liên hệ' is the plain VN heading for what the column holds and parallels 'Hồ sơ doanh nghiệp'.

decisions.legal_column_heading. The spec's informal C_ENTITY/C_TAXID both project to ledger id C019 (entity + tax code, proof-bank §F). Heading names what the column holds — entity, tax code, group membership — and promises no terms/privacy document.
decisions.status_legend — states the label system, never a colour. Uses the badge strings verbatim: status.shipped 'Đã có', status.roadmap 'Dự kiến' (glossary shipped-label / roadmap-label).
